mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a flight to safety away from equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in > 60% of such events are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) signals weak labor demand, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in > 60% of such episodes are not significantly negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 200K indicates strengthening labor demand, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in > 60% of such events are not significantly positive, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
